items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: they knew me because I had a chance to either go with Earl Hines or Chick Webb.

ctx.x: Well, you played the theater circuit and --

That's all. Playing back in shows and things of this sort. No, I didn't really get to do any playing, any real playing around there. Mostly show work. But I had been in New York. I knew New York, and I knew a lot of musicians around there and they knew me because I had a chance to either go with Earl Hines or Chick Webb.
